My dear Miss Yonge	
Your scheme as decided by [Miss Sewell](/person/1301) and yourself seems to me very admirable.[^1] The one question is the compactness and vivid unity, which will be hard rather in an [illegible] such as you propose. But with artists like yourself [and] Miss Sewell there should be no difficulty[.] the thing ought to be very interesting indeed.
[I](/person/939)have read all the [Prince and the Page](/book/61) down to the present month. I think it delightful, and hope it will make a very nice Christmas book. But I confess I do not feel quite clear about the [illustration](/topic/167).[^2] At a first glance it does not quite please me. The Architecture in any case should be more subordinated, but my first impression of the figures is rather that they are weak. I will write more about it tomorrow.
ever most truly yours
A. Macmillan
The enclosed cheque is for both your [story](/book/62) & [paper](/book/59) - which [illegible] capital.


[^1]: The scheme was for the book which became [Historical Selections](/book/71).
[^2]: CMY was trying to persuade him to use a drawing by [Katie Johns](/person/887).
